general_rules.description: Internal team members (same domain @strategyco.com) receive casual greetings (first name only) and closings (initials or first name), regardless of seniority.

External clients and senior stakeholders receive formal greetings ('Dear [First Name]' or 'Dear [Title] [Last Name]') with full signature block closings ('Best regards, James Conseil Senior Consultant StrategyCo | London').
Emails to internal team include action items formatted as numbered lists with clear ownership and deadlines.
Client-facing emails (external) open with context-setting or gratitude and include structured sections (e.g., workstreams, key risks, next steps) with bullet points.
Emails to administrative staff (Emma Phillips) use casual tone with direct, task-focused requests and minimal preamble.
Formal emails to external contacts include detailed context, investment figures, timelines, and governance frameworks to establish credibility and structure.
Feedback to team members combines praise ('Well done', 'Good work', 'Nice job') with specific, constructive comments and next steps.
Strategic/business development emails to external contacts emphasize value proposition, industry expertise, and phased approaches to build long-term relationships.
